protocol.shared_encoder: two 32-channel convolutions used by both the forward and inverse heads
protocol.inverse_target: normalized observed action coordinates from before and after features
protocol.selection: lowest forward-only validation objective; inverse loss affects fitting but not checkpoint selection
protocol.paired_action_metric: changed-pixel-weighted MSE; correct action should be lower than paired wrong action
protocol.inverse_metric: normalized coordinate mean absolute error; lower is better

finding: The shared encoder learns observed inverse localization, including on fresh-seed screens, but this does not translate into reliable forward action grounding. The inverse-weighted models have lower validation forward objective yet worse held-out forward error than the same architecture without inverse fitting. No candidate passes paired wrong-action controls.
limitations: Exploratory MiniWoB first-click data; no unseen real desktop environments, task success, or multistep traces.
All selected rows are clicks, so action-type accuracy is uninformative; inverse results measure coordinate recovery only.
The held-out task families were inspected in earlier experiments, so this is not an untouched preregistered benchmark.
A before/after inverse probe observes the outcome and is not a forward planning capability.
Weights are ignored research artifacts and are not loaded into the live UiJepaPredictor. No Jev parity or safety claim.
